_doc: The single-station test sites of mppp.ibr (Christian, 10 Nov 2026: 'We'll use these three as the test sites ... the single sites should come from a config file'). python -m mppp single-sites [LABEL ...] runs them: the dense step in the block, then mesh / depthmaps --photometry / ods into <out>/<label>/ (rover masked out) and <out>/<label>/with_rover/ (rover shown). Per station: 'site' (a site of mppp/data/sites.json; the block is its Navcam WORK folder) or 'work' (a block folder), 'station' (S003D2046 / 3_2046), 'frames' (the dense step's frames: 'images' [names], 'scale' (0.5: the half-resolution frames), 'sequences' [NCAM...]); optional 'variants' (rover, masked; the rover shown is the default since 0.96.1, run first), 'ods_exclude' (frames left out of the panorama, both eyes of a pair: an NLF stem drops its NRF partner), 'mesh_args' / 'depthmaps_args' / 'ods_args' (extra arguments), 'note'. Top level: 'dense_args' / 'mesh_args' / 'depthmaps_args' / 'ods_args' for every station (and per station the same keys); 'ods_args' --bits 16: the panorama from 16-bit linear frames.
